games.description: Two solo visits to DREAM LOGIC: first the customizable entity mode, then the liminal story. Sark makes and outruns his own entity, explores pools and puzzles, flies through the clouds, and reaches the story’s final chase.
games.title: DREAM LOGIC

games.description: A co-op escape-room journey with NFEN and Diction. The archive follows the original rooms, caves, grassrooms, sewers, terror hotel and fun level, including failed attempts and completed returns, then the later pool and train-station update. The differently capitalised checklist categories refer to this same game.
games.title: Inside the Backrooms

games.description: Sark follows a found camera into a series of collect-and-escape levels, brute-forcing a book code and finishing with an almond-water hunt.
games.title: The Backrooms Footage

games.description: Sark wanders through yellow halls, pools and offices, follows a distant figure and later makes a short return to the tape.
